THE BUSINESS GAP

Why conversation intelligence—not CRM alone?

CRM records outcomes; conversations explain them. Without the customer context, leaders can see pipeline status but not why a buyer hesitates, where a salesperson needs support or which product issue keeps recurring.

01

Critical context depends on manual entry

Post-call updates often miss budget, decision roles, competitors, real objections and commitments.

02

Winning behavior stays with a few people

The questions, listening and objection handling of top performers remain hard to observe and difficult to teach.

03

Customer voice never reaches decision-makers

After repeated retelling, product and marketing teams receive conclusions without the original, verifiable context.

FROM CONVERSATION TO ACTION

Four steps from conversation to action

Each step preserves source context and human review. AI accelerates organization and discovery; salespeople and leaders retain the final judgment.

01

Connect communication sources

With clear consent and data boundaries, connect in-person recordings, private messaging or existing business systems.

02

Identify business signals

Extract needs, budget, stakeholders, timing, buying signals, objections, competitor mentions and follow-up actions.

03

Return insight to the workflow

Give salespeople summaries, managers coaching evidence, and write structured outcomes into CRM or collaboration tools.

04

Build organizational intelligence

Analyze recurring needs, loss reasons, sales behavior and product feedback across conversations.

START WITH THE RIGHT TEAM

Which teams should pilot first?

  • High-value purchases depend on consultative conversations
  • Long sales cycles involve several decision-makers
  • Customer relationships are vulnerable to staff turnover
  • A CRM exists, but frontline data quality is inconsistent
  • The team wants to validate AI with real data before replacing core systems
FAQ

Sales conversation intelligence FAQ

How is this different from transcription?＋

Transcription captures what was said. TellWin identifies customer state, business signals, actions and cross-conversation patterns, then returns them to the sales workflow.

Do we need to replace our CRM?＋

No. A pilot can start with one team or communication source and write structured results into the CRM or collaboration system you already use.

How do you handle privacy and consent?＋

Before a pilot, we define notice and consent, purpose, access, retention and redaction. Private or regional deployment can be assessed for sensitive environments.

How quickly can we evaluate a pilot?＋

Start with one measurable workflow and real data, then decide whether to expand from observed adoption and evaluation results rather than a fixed promise.
